high_confidence_unactioned.title: High confidence, no action taken
high_confidence_unactioned.description: Items scored >= 0.8 confidence but no action was taken — useful for validating dry-run mode catches real violations
high_confidence_unactioned.sql: SELECT reddit_id, subreddit, author, content_preview, violation_type, confidence, reasoning, created_at FROM decisions WHERE confidence >= 0.8 AND action_taken = 'none' ORDER BY confidence DESC, created_at DESC

recent_flagged.title: Recent flagged items
recent_flagged.description: Last 100 items flagged for human review — the primary moderation queue
recent_flagged.sql: SELECT reddit_id, subreddit, author, content_preview, violation_type, confidence, reasoning, created_at FROM decisions WHERE action_taken = 'flagged' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

recent_removals.title: Recent auto-removals
recent_removals.description: Last 100 automatically removed items — review for false positives
recent_removals.sql: SELECT reddit_id, subreddit, author, content_preview, violation_type, confidence, reasoning, created_at FROM decisions WHERE action_taken = 'removed' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

violations_by_subreddit.title: Violations by subreddit
violations_by_subreddit.description: Aggregated violation counts and average confidence per subreddit
violations_by_subreddit.sql: SELECT subreddit, violation_type, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(AVG(confidence), 3) AS avg_confidence, SUM(CASE WHEN action_taken = 'removed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS removed, SUM(CASE WHEN action_taken = 'flagged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flagged FROM decisions WHERE violation_type != 'none' GROUP BY subreddit, violation_type ORDER BY total DESC

repeat_offenders.title: Repeat offenders
repeat_offenders.description: Authors with 2 or more violations, their violation types, and average confidence
repeat_offenders.sql: SELECT author, COUNT(*) AS violation_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT violation_type) AS violation_types, ROUND(AVG(confidence), 3) AS avg_confidence, MIN(created_at) AS first_seen, MAX(created_at) AS last_seen FROM decisions WHERE violation_type != 'none' GROUP BY author HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY violation_count DESC

confidence_distribution.title: Confidence distribution
confidence_distribution.description: Bucketed confidence ranges with removal and flag counts — useful for tuning action thresholds
confidence_distribution.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN confidence < 0.2 THEN '0.0–0.2' WHEN confidence < 0.4 THEN '0.2–0.4' WHEN confidence < 0.6 THEN '0.4–0.6' WHEN confidence < 0.8 THEN '0.6–0.8' ELSE '0.8–1.0' END AS confidence_range, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN action_taken = 'removed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS removed, SUM(CASE WHEN action_taken = 'flagged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flagged, SUM(CASE WHEN action_taken = 'none' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_action FROM decisions GROUP BY confidence_range ORDER BY confidence_range

daily_activity.title: Daily activity (last 30 days)
daily_activity.description: Per-day totals of items analyzed, violations found, removals, and flags
daily_activity.sql: SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day, COUNT(*) AS analyzed, SUM(CASE WHEN violation_type != 'none' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS violations, SUM(CASE WHEN action_taken = 'removed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS removed, SUM(CASE WHEN action_taken = 'flagged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flagged FROM decisions WHERE created_at >= DATE('now', '-30 days') GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC

decisions.description: Every post/comment analyzed by RuleKeeperBot with the resulting action

columns.reddit_id: Reddit fullname identifier (e.g. t3_abc123 for posts, t1_xyz789 for comments)
columns.subreddit: Subreddit where the content was posted
columns.author: Reddit username of the content author
columns.content_preview: Truncated preview of the post title or comment body
columns.violation_type: Type of violation detected (spam, toxicity, scam, etc.) or 'none' if clean
columns.reasoning: Model-generated explanation of why the content was flagged or cleared
columns.action_taken: Action performed: removed, flagged, or none
columns.created_at: UTC timestamp when the decision was recorded

watermarks.description: Last processed post/comment ID per subreddit — used to resume polling without reprocessing

columns.content_type: Type of content being polled (post or comment)
columns.last_id: Reddit fullname of the last item processed
columns.updated_at: UTC timestamp of the last watermark update
